summary: Snohomish County, WA lookout site: camp 1929, 12x12 cab 1930, Andy Holland 1931; cab removed or burned 1967; no source describes the summit today.

facts.design: 12'x12' frame cab built 1930 after a 1929 tent camp (firelookout.com instead says gable-roofed L-4 cab)
facts.status_note: Cab removed or burned in 1967; no source describes what remains on the summit

access.note: Hiking trail; most of the final forest road was closed for many years and reopened in 2020 per WillhiteWeb; conditions may change year to year

visit.trail_note: About 2 miles each way with roughly 2,000 feet of gain; the final traverse to the high point includes an exposed stretch over cliffs (WillhiteWeb)

events.note: Tent camp set up on the site before the cab was built
12'x12' frame cab per the register and Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com says gable-roofed L-4 cab; WillhiteWeb says a frame cab was built and rock blasted away
Andy Holland named as lookout, described as the first person to occupy the new lookout
Panorama photographs taken from the cab roof in September 1935
Harry Gladsjo working in the lookout, per a July 1961 Arlington Times item and WillhiteWeb
Register says removed in 1967; firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts say destroyed; WillhiteWeb says burned in 1967
Registered March 25, 2012 as FFLOS US 1233; nominated by Ray Kresek

notes_for_editor: Design conflict: register and Forest Lookouts say 12'x12' frame cab (1930); firelookout.com says gable-roofed L-4 cab. Blasting date conflict: WillhiteWeb ties rock blasting to the 1930 build; Forest Lookouts quotes a June 1932 Six Twenty-Six item about rock being shot away. Removal: register says removed 1967; others say destroyed or burned 1967. Record height_m 3.7 is not used as a tower or cab-floor height: the only height found is a 1950 NGS description of a building 12 feet tall, which does not say it was the lookout; left in facts out of caution, editor to decide. Road access reopened 2020 per a trip report; no official closure notice found. No photos with usable URL and licence were added.
